notes.title: The Speedtrain Update
notes.content:
Loot Train version 1.1.0 is here!

With it comes:

-A whole new gamemode that takes the core Loot Train experience and refines it for faster pace gameplay! This mode is called Speedtrain! This mode can be reached immediately by entering the red portal once the fortress hub is unlocked. This mode has a much higher loot yield than the main mode and has 10 difficulties.

-5 New enemies exclusive to Speedtrain!

-3 New incredibly powerful items are also available in Speedtrain!

-Misc. items that used to be coming soon are now in the game and unlock immediately!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
This is the first part of the 1.1.0 update. We have decided to release the 1.1.0 update in parts so you can at least experience something while your waiting. 

This update contains the following features:

- Countless bug fixes

- Countless balance changes

- Added new unlockable items

- Added Stratums

- Added a new Hero

- Added Compendium

- Added 6 new achievements

- Added Scary Room
